items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I had Hunter Gray... He was a nice musician, and so we played there

ctx.x: back through there, we got some more bookings, through the west coast and I was working on that in order to get back there. I got back out there and I don't know what in the world happened but Spurgeon couldn't go on that trip or something, something happened with him, but I had Hunter Gray, a little fellow we called "Shoe Sole".
He was a nice musician, and so we played there and had Butch Luckett--
